usedFor: Shopify holds checkouts and orders, and Chatlayer sends a customer message through “Send Message” when a checkout is abandoned.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Send Message” in Chatlayer
bestTemplate.why: An abandoned checkout has a customer's email or phone, so Chatlayer can follow up.

watchOut: “Send Message” in Chatlayer reaches a customer, so each message waits in Needs you for approval.
